set.question: Which sentence describes a regular habit?

options: I normally send messages during the day.
I sent several messages yesterday during the meeting.
I will send a lot of messages tomorrow afternoon.
I often communicate with my colleagues by video call.
I never communicate with my colleagues by video call.
I used to communicate only by letter, many years ago.

template.prompt: Say that you normally send messages during the day and often communicate with your colleagues by video call.
template.answer: Normalmente envío mensajes durante el día y a menudo me comunico con mis compañeros por videollamada.

template.prompt: Say that every day you contact your family by phone, while with your colleagues you usually use messages and video calls.
template.answer: Cada día contacto con mi familia por teléfono, mientras que con mis compañeros suelo utilizar mensajes y videollamadas.

old: "I can use four new communication terms."
new: "I can use the new words for communicating."

set.question: Which expression signals contrast in a discussion?
Which sentence uses the present perfect?
Which auxiliary is used in the present perfect?

template.prompt: Say that technology has changed the way we communicate and that many people have changed their habits.
template.answer: La tecnología ha cambiado nuestra forma de comunicarnos y muchas personas han cambiado sus hábitos.

template.prompt: Say that you have recently updated your device and that you have changed some communication habits.
template.answer: He actualizado mi dispositivo recientemente y he cambiado algunos hábitos de comunicación.

options: While some prefer messages, others prefer to talk by phone.
Most of the people prefer messages to any other way of talking.
A few people prefer talking by phone, but only at work.

template.prompt: Compare two communication methods: video calls are more immediate than email, although an in-person conversation can be as effective as a video call.
template.answer: La videollamada es más inmediata que el correo electrónico, aunque una conversación presencial puede ser tan eficaz como una videollamada.

set.question: Which verb form completes «Si no tuviéramos internet, ___ más del teléfono»?

options: It would be very difficult for me to do without my phone.
It is easy for me to use my phone every day at work.
I stopped using my phone yesterday after the meeting.

template.prompt: Say two consequences of having no digital access: it would be harder to work from home and we would have to communicate in another way.
template.answer: Si no hubiera acceso digital, sería más difícil trabajar desde casa y tendríamos que comunicarnos de otra manera.

set.question: Which expression helps organise two sides of a discussion?
options: Por una parte... por otra parte... [On the one hand... on the other hand...]
Al principio... luego... después... [At first... then... later...]
Primero... después... finalmente... [First... then... finally...]
On the one hand, technology allows us to communicate quickly.
Technology prevents people from communicating with their families.
Technology only changes the privacy of people at work.
On the other hand, it has also changed our relationship with privacy.
On the one hand, privacy has disappeared completely.
Technology has not changed our relationship with privacy at all.
If we used screens less, perhaps we would have more time to talk face to face.
If we use screens less, we had more time to talk yesterday evening.
If we used screens more, we would perhaps have less time to talk tomorrow.

template.prompt: Discuss one advantage (technology makes communication easier) and one disadvantage (it can affect our privacy) of digital life, using por una parte … por otra parte.
template.answer: Por una parte, la tecnología facilita la comunicación; por otra parte, puede afectar a nuestra privacidad.

template.prompt: Give your view: you think we can find a balance between being connected and having time to talk face to face.
template.answer: Creo que podemos buscar un equilibrio entre estar conectados y tener tiempo para hablar cara a cara.

template.prompt: Say that technology has changed the way we communicate and that video calls are now more common than before.
template.answer: La tecnología ha cambiado nuestra forma de comunicarnos y ahora las videollamadas son más habituales que antes.

template.prompt: Give a hypothetical consequence: if we used screens less, perhaps we would have more time to talk face to face.
template.answer: Si utilizáramos menos las pantallas, quizá tendríamos más tiempo para hablar cara a cara.

template.answer: Normalmente uso mensajes para trabajar, pero la tecnología ha cambiado mis hábitos y ahora las videollamadas son más habituales que antes.

template.prompt: Give one advantage (it is fast and effective), one disadvantage (it can affect privacy) and a hypothetical consequence (if we used screens less, perhaps we would have more time to talk face to face).
